body.heading: Where in the world is Somalia?
paragraphs: Somalia is a country in Eastern Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Somalia is Mogadishu.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Somalia speak Somali and Arabic.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Somalia is the Somali shilling.

body.heading: How big is Somalia?
paragraphs: Somalia covers about 638,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Chad.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: At Laas Geel, rock shelters hold some of Africa's finest ancient paintings — cattle and people painted in red and white thousands of years ago, remarkably bright today.
Mogadishu's Lido Beach is the capital's beloved seaside, where families swim, play football on the sand and eat fresh fish as boats come in.
